original: We should keep looking for Taichi\nand Agumon until we find them.
There's no point. It's been a\nmonth, and we still have no idea\nwhere they are.
We don't know where he is, either.\nHow would we even look for him?
I'm tired of this. I wanna go home\nright noooooow!
I don't want him to start\ncrying...we're leaving to go look\nfor Taichi, after all.
we're leaving to go look for\nTaichi, after all.
It's impossible. We don't have\nenough clues.
I'm sure we'll figure out both\nTaichi's location and the secrets\nof the Crests.
I don't know, it doesn't seem very\nlikely. I don't want to get\neveryone's hopes up.
I understand. In that case, I\ndon't mind going with only\nTentomon.
I'll be goin' with him. Don't pay\nus any mind.
Jouuuuuuu! Find a ton of food,\nokay?
Okay! You shouldn't hang around\ndoing nothing either, Mimi.
Jou and Gomamon are out late.
I wonder if Jou got lost...
Takeru, Mimi, get some sleep. I'll\ntake my turn at watch.
Don't worry about Jou. I'm sure\nhe'll find a way back, somehow.
I'm sick of this! It's nothing but\nwalking through the desert!
But we were just at an oasis...
I wanna go back to the oasis!
Then what are you gonna do? Live\nat the oasis?
I'll figure that out later! I'm\ngoing back!
Looks like it's just us now.
Let's go, Takeru. We'll probably\nget out of the desert if we keep\ngoing.
Hm? What's this? The Digivice is\nreacting to something.
It's coming from that direction.\nThe others must be over there!
Let's head to wherever it's coming\nfrom!
It's Tokomon! Hang in there,\nTokomon! Are you okay?
Did you get beaten up by an enemy\nDigimon, Tokomon?
No, I didn't. I'm just tired and\nhungry...
Take it from the top. Tell us what\nhappened to the others.
Hey, Yamato. I wonder where\neveryone went?
Don't worry. We can get by without\nthem.
Doesn't look like we have any more\nenemies like Devimon and Etemon.
Yamato, we should go back and look\nfor Taichi.
I'm sorry, don't cry! I'm sure\nTaichi and Agumon are doing okay\nsomewhere.
Yeah, just wait here. It'll just\nbe a few hours. I'll be back soon.
Yamato...Yamato! He was only\nsupposed to be taking a quick\nlook...
He said he'd be back soon!\nWaaaaaaaaaah!
Huuuuh! That's bad! Okay, I'll go\nlook for him. What's his name?
I found him, but he gave me a\nmessage.
Yamato said he doesn't want to see\nyou again.
He said he really, really hates\nyou and doesn't want to be your\nbrother anymore.
Oh, and he also said that he hates\nyou 'cause you're a crybaby.
Yamato wouldn't say anything like\nthat! Don't lie to Takeru!
Lie? If you've got evidence I'm\nlying, show it to me!
Saying that kind of thing's called\nslander. You can go to court over\nthat. Wanna do it?
Don't blame Tokomon, Takeru. He's\njust jealous of my relationship\nwith you.
No way! If you want me to\napologize, then I'm out of here!
Do you really want me to leave?
Do you really want me to leave?
Yeah, go ahead! Oh yeah, there\naren't any more enemies around, so\nI don't need these, either!
And Takeru threw away the Tag and\nDigivice.
I'm worried about Yamato, but we \nneed to take care of Takeru first.\nTake us to that amusement park.
Heeheehee! Look, Takeru, you can\nride anything you want! Isn't it\nfun?
Hey, Takeru, by any chance, are\nyou still worried about Tokomon?
I don't care about him! But I\nwonder if he's okay by himself...
(I can't get him to forget about\nTokomon after all. I have to do\nsomething...)
Nah, he can do whatever he wants.
Ah, Takeru. I just remembered I\nhave to do an errand! I'll be\nright back, heehee!
Thank goodness. I was worried, I\nwas so worried..
Have you realized what you did\nwrong?
Hey, now. This isn't the time to\nfight amongst ourselves. We should\ngo find Yamato.
Everyone left me. First Sora, and\nnow even Yamato.
Everyone hates me, because I cry\neasily, because I'm a kid.
I don't know what PicoDevimon told\nyou, but Yamato doesn't hate you.
He started hating me because I was\nonly worrying about you!
Hey, Taichi, I wanna be *your*\nbrother instead!
Look, there's something we want to\nask you.
W-what do you want to ask?
He said he didn't want to see\nTakeru anymore.
Can you take us to Yamato?
It's a bit far from here.
Really?...Ah, hey! Why don't we\neat before we go?
Here, I found some delicious\nmushrooms. Eat up!
(These are the Mushrooms of\nForgetfulness! One bite and you'll\nforget everything in your past!)
Agumon, make some flames so we can\ncook them!
Just a minute, I need to use the\nbathroom!
Hm! The same mushrooms are growing\nhere! Can we *really* eat these?
Don't eat them! If you eat them,\nyou'll lose all your memories!
That's weird, but if what I just\nheard is true...aaaah, this is\nbad!
Agumon! We've been waiting for you\nso you can start the fire to cook\nthese with!
Don't worry! We've got enough for\nyou, too.
See, he can't eat them, because\nthese mushrooms make you lose all\nyour memories!
You were lying about Yamato too,\nweren't you?!
Horrible...you're horrible. I'm\nsorry for how I treated you,\nTokomon.
Looks like we've put this\nmisunderstanding aside.
Looks like we've put this\nmisunderstanding aside.
Enough with that! It's because of\nyou that I was able to evolve\nagain.
I have to apologize to Yamato\nlater, too.
Anyway, good job figuring out\nthose mushrooms, Agumon.
No, it wasn't me. I heard a voice.
I-I sincerely apologize! The Crest\nof Hope has regained its light.
The distortions in this world were\naffecting the real world.
So before we go back home, we'll\nhave to get rid of the distortions\nhere.
We'll have to get everyone to work\ntogether. Including you, Takeru.
That's the spirit! Okay, let's go\nfind the others!
